quotes.text: Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.
quotes.closest: Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.

quotes.text: Start in a squat position with your knees bent, back straight, and your feet about shoulder-width apart.
quotes.closest: Start in a squat position with your knees bent, back straight, and your feet about shoulder-width apart.

quotes.text: Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms at sides, core braced, shoulders relaxed.
quotes.closest: Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms at sides, core braced, shoulders relaxed.

quotes.text: Stand with your feet together and your hands by your sides.
quotes.closest: Stand with your feet together and your hands by your sides.

quotes.text: Squat down and place your hands flat on the floor in front of your feet shoulder-width apart.
quotes.closest: Squat down and place your hands flat on the floor in front of your feet shoulder-width apart.

quotes.text: Squat down and place hands on floor in front of feet.
quotes.closest: Squat down and place hands on floor in front of feet.

quotes.text: From a standing position, descend into a crouch/squat. As you get low enough, plant your arms in front of you.
quotes.closest: From a standing position, descend into a crouch/squat. As you get low enough, plant your arms in front of you.

quotes.text: Place hands on the floor first, before pushing your legs out into plank position.
quotes.closest: Place hands on the floor first, before pushing your legs out into plank position.

quotes.text: Once you have stable contact with the ground, kick your legs out behind so you end up in a straight-arm plank position.
quotes.closest: Once you have stable contact with the ground, kick your legs out behind so you end up in a straight-arm plank position.

quotes.text: Kick feet back to high plank position.
quotes.closest: Kick feet back to high plank position.

quotes.text: From the straight-arm plank position, take a breath, brace your core, and lower your torso to the floor like you would for a standard push-up.
quotes.closest: From the straight-arm plank position, take a breath, brace your core, and lower your torso to the floor like you would for a standard push-up.

quotes.text: Bend your arms and lower your chest to lightly touch the floor.
quotes.closest: Bend your arms and lower your chest to lightly touch the floor.

quotes.text: Push back up to full arm extension.
quotes.closest: Push back up to full arm extension.

quotes.text: As you press your body off the floor, “jump” your legs back underneath your body and release your grip, such that you return to the crouching position you began with. In one fluid motion, drive upwards with the legs and perform a small vertical jump.
quotes.closest: As you press your body off the floor, “jump” your legs back underneath your body and release your grip, such that you return to the crouching position you began with. In one fluid motion, drive upwards with the legs and perform a small vertical jump.

quotes.text: Jump your feet in and under your body, knees close to your elbows.
quotes.closest: Jump your feet in and under your body, knees close to your elbows.

quotes.text: Explode upward into jump, arms overhead.
quotes.closest: Explode upward into jump, arms overhead.

quotes.text: Keeping your body straight from head to heels, do one pushup. Remember not to let your back sag or to stick your butt in the air.
quotes.closest: Keeping your body straight from head to heels, do one pushup. Remember not to let your back sag or to stick your butt in the air.

quotes.text: During both stages of the movement, strive to ensure you properly brace your core and keep your spine in a neutral position. Don’t allow your lower back to dip or sag along the way.
quotes.closest: During both stages of the movement, strive to ensure you properly brace your core and keep your spine in a neutral position. Don’t allow your lower back to dip or sag along the way.

quotes.text: Lower to full squat with thighs parallel; plank from head to heels straight; push-up chest to 1-2 inches from ground; full extension on jump.
quotes.closest: Lower to full squat with thighs parallel; plank from head to heels straight; push-up chest to 1-2 inches from ground; full extension on jump.

quotes.text: Keep your core tight; do not let your hips drop out of proper alignment.
quotes.closest: Keep your core tight; do not let your hips drop out of proper alignment.

quotes.text: Leap into the air off of flat feet if possible to reduce the strain on your knees.
